title: Optimization for Medical Image Segmentation: Theory and Practice When Evaluating With Dice Score or Jaccard Index
mechanism: Theory and six tasks: Dice and Jaccard losses approximate each other, weighted CE has no weighting that optimises them, Tversky drifts from the optimum as weights move.
adaptation: Guides the benchmark loss axis (CE vs CE+Dice vs CE+JML vs Lovasz under one protocol) and warns that Tversky trades IoU for recall.
min_experiment: No separate run; read as design guidance for the benchmark loss baselines.
evidence: R: metric-sensitive losses beat CE-based losses on six medical tasks, across object sizes and class ratios.
